### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one nascent run (quantification/, coverage_graphs/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV): library id in a column named sample (or the first column), the hours of each library in TIME_COL, a time_point label, and any factor. Enables the group filter and colours. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table library-id column. Auto-detected as the first column; defaults to 'sample'. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design column the dashboards group, colour and filter libraries by. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |
| `TIME_COL` | — | Design column holding each library's time in hours. Without it (or without a design table) the time is read off a library id ending in a duration (30min, 2h, 1d). |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC name of the assembly the run aligned to (--genome; hg38, mm10): the axis and gene lane of the genome tracks. |
| `TRACKS_URI` | — | s3:// or https:// folder holding the run's results (the folder DATA_ROOT mirrors), to read the genome-browser bigWigs in place instead of uploading them from DATA_ROOT. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

### Data collections

### Conditional routes

Rows are data collections; columns are the variables you set or `params.json` flags auto-detected from the run. Each filled cell is the effect of **setting** that variable; an **empty cell** means that variable leaves the collection unchanged. (18 collections are unaffected by any variable — present on every run.)

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`bedtools/strand_bins.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bedtools/strand_bins.py) | Strand-split coverage in 250 kb windows, one row per library per window. | `sample`, `chromosome`, `start`, `end`, `position`, `plus_rpm`, `minus_rpm`, `signal_rpm`, `log2_signal`, `plus_share_pct` |
| [`bedtools/strand_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bedtools/strand_summary.py) | Per-library totals of the strand-split coverage bedGraphs. | `sample`, `plus_read_bases`, `minus_read_bases`, `total_read_bases`, `covered_mb`, `max_depth`, `plus_share_pct`, `mito_pct`, `off_main_pct`, `hotspot_share_pct` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/chromosome_signal.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/chromosome_signal.py) | Each chromosome's share of the nascent signal, per time point. | `chromosome`, `time_point`, `time_h`, `time_order`, `time_axis`, `phase`, `share_pct`, `plus_share_pct`, `contig_order`, `log2_ratio`, `abs_log2_ratio` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/gene_dynamics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/gene_dynamics.py) | Per gene: how far its nascent transcription moves over the time course, and when. | `gene_id`, `chromosome`, `start`, `end`, `strand`, `length`, `baseline_log2_cpm`, `mean_log2_cpm`, `dynamic_range`, `peak_log2fc`, `abs_peak_log2fc`, `last_log2fc`, `peak_time_point`, `peak_time_h`, `peak_phase`, `n_changed`, `direction`, `response`, `rank` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/gene_trajectories.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/gene_trajectories.py) | Per gene and time point: nascent transcription and its change from the baseline. | `gene_id`, `time_point`, `time_h`, `time_order`, `time_axis`, `phase`, `log2_cpm`, `log2fc`, `direction`, `response` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/sample_drift.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/sample_drift.py) | How far transcription has moved at each time point, as two curves over time. | `comparison`, `time_point`, `time_h`, `time_order`, `time_axis`, `correlation` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/sample_similarity.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/sample_similarity.py) | Where each library sits among the others: a PCA and its correlation along the time course. | `sample`, `time_point`, `time_h`, `time_order`, `time_axis`, `phase`, `pc1`, `pc2`, `pc3`, `pc1_variance`, `pc2_variance`, `pc3_variance`, `corr_to_baseline`, `corr_to_previous` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/samples.py) | The nf-core/nascent sample hub: one row per library, its time point and its QC. | `sample`, `time_point`, `time_h`, `time_order`, `time_axis`, `phase`, `assigned_reads`, `genes_detected`, `genes_detected_pct`, `top100_share_pct`, `total_read_bases`, `plus_share_pct`, `mito_pct`, `off_main_pct`, `hotspot_share_pct`, `strand_skew_pct` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/signal_window_dynamics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/signal_window_dynamics.py) | Per 250 kb window: how far its nascent signal moves over the time course, and when. | `window_id`, `chromosome`, `start`, `end`, `position`, `mean_rpm`, `baseline_log2_signal`, `dynamic_range`, `peak_log2fc`, `abs_peak_log2fc`, `last_log2fc`, `peak_time_point`, `peak_time_h`, `peak_phase`, `n_changed`, `trend`, `rank` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/signal_window_heatmap.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/signal_window_heatmap.py) | The windows that change most, as a window x time point matrix for a heatmap. | `window_id`, `trend` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/signal_window_series.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/signal_window_series.py) | Each compared window's log2 fold change at every time point, with its trend. | `window_id`, `chromosome`, `trend`, `time_point`, `time_h`, `time_order`, `time_axis`, `phase`, `log2fc` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/strand_bins.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/strand_bins.py) | The binned strand windows with their libraries in time order. | `sample`, `chromosome`, `start`, `end`, `position`, `plus_rpm`, `minus_rpm`, `signal_rpm`, `log2_signal`, `plus_share_pct` |
| [`nf-core/nascent/top_gene_heatmap.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/nascent/recipes/top_gene_heatmap.py) | The most dynamic genes as a gene x time point matrix, for a heatmap. | `gene_id`, `response` |
